entities.summary: Durrani Empire, a political institution in Afghanistan during Mughal-Safavid Rivalry and Durrani Empire (1747–1826). Grew from Babur and Babur and Mughal Control. Led to the emergence of Third Battle of Panipat — Durrani forces defeat the Maratha Confederacy and First Anglo-Afghan War.
